answers.author: catherinebreslin
answers.text: Not too long thankfully! A few folks were walking through. 🙏🏻

replies.text: That black umbrella in the middle of all that orange is doing all the work - the wet path, the bare branches, and the fog swallowing the far end. Did the rain let up just as you got there, or did you walk straight into it for this one?

answers.author: charhedman
answers.text: Thank you! It was raining when I got there, but not enough to stop me. The rain adds moodiness. 🤗

replies.text: Three tiny figures and all that empty concrete - the couple arm in arm and the lone man on his phone, with the fence holding the bottom edge. What made you keep the frame that wide instead of stepping in closer?

How long did the cat hold that pose in the middle of the road? Sitting dead center, staring straight down the lens, with the whole street going soft behind it - the film grain makes it feel like a still from another decade.
This one glows - leaves floating on the water, trees reflected above them, red and gold on blue. Was this the last color before the trees went bare?
Day and night in one post - the red facade glowing in the sun, then the same street gone dark with one warm window lit. Which of the two did you shoot first?
